purpose: Observe a real already-supported Pulsar editing surface using a temporary JavaScript file and determine whether a bounded set of useful status-bar targets are exact-visible to local Vision while remaining unavailable as semantic CLICK targets. This session is discovery-only and does not promote any built-in caller contract or skill.
safety: Pulsar must not already be running; otherwise the session is BLOCKED
the opened file is created under a temporary directory and is never modified by the test
no pointer or keyboard action is delivered after launch/activation
semantic candidate classification happens before local Vision provider selection
local Vision is selected only if at least one predefined candidate is a structured semantic CLICK gap
no raw semantic snapshot, screenshot, OCR payload or coordinates are persisted
the test initiates no external network request
Pulsar, Computer Control runtime and temporary files are cleaned up
PASS means DIAGNOSTIC_OBSERVED only; it does not validate or ship a visual fallback contract

onPass.next: Select at most one candidate with exact Vision single-match plus structured semantic CLICK gap and a deterministic surface identity; then design an independently verifiable postcondition before any action-delivery validation or built-in promotion. If no candidate qualifies, do not weaken matching; inspect the next supported application.
